tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Reusable Configuration
tool.description: create a portable configuration for mapped, batch, or automated analyses
tool.command: touch '$config_output' '$config_report' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$config_output' '$config_report' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && config_args=( python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py configure --mode '$measurement.strategy.analysis_mode' --radiation '$measurement.radiation' --instrument-mode '$measurement.instrument_mode' --allowed-elements '$chemistry.sample_elements' --background-mode '$background.background_mode' --background-type '$background.background_type' --background-terms '$background.background_terms' --output '$config_output' --report '$config_report' ) && #if str($chemistry.environment_elements) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') config_args+=(--environment-elements '$chemistry.environment_elements') && #end if #if str($pattern.limit_start) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') config_args+=(--limit-start '$pattern.limit_start') && #end if #if str($pattern.limit_end) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') config_args+=(--limit-end '$pattern.limit_end') && #end if #for $region in $pattern.excluded_regions config_args+=(--exclude-region '${region.start}:${region.end}') && #end for #for $preset in $pattern.reference_masks.presets config_args+=(--reference-mask-preset '$preset') && #end for config_args+=($pattern.reference_masks.include_kbeta) && #if str($measurement.strategy.analysis_mode) == 'rapid' config_args+=( --phases-per-hypothesis '$measurement.strategy.phases_per_hypothesis' --rapid-stage-output-limit '$measurement.strategy.stage_output_limit' --gsas-validation-limit '$measurement.strategy.gsas_validation_limit' --rapid-workers '$measurement.strategy.parallel_workers' $measurement.strategy.family_variants $measurement.strategy.final_polish ) && #else config_args+=(--runtime-profile '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.profile_kind') && #if str($measurement.strategy.full_profile.profile_kind) == 'custom' config_args+=( --max-passes '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.max_passes' --min-phase-percent '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.min_phase_percent' --full-top-n-ml '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.top_n_ml' --full-nudge-candidates '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.nudge_candidates' --full-cell-length-tolerance '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.cell_length_tolerance' --full-cell-angle-tolerance '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.cell_angle_tolerance' --full-nudge-samples '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.nudge_samples' --full-nudge-representatives '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.nudge_representatives' --full-compare-candidates '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.compare_candidates' --full-compare-cycles '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.compare_cycles' --full-rwp-improvement-threshold '$measurement.strategy.full_profile.rwp_improvement_threshold' ) && #end if #end if #if str($magnetic.magnetic_check.enabled) == 'yes' config_args+=(--magnetic-precheck --magnetic-q-max '$magnetic.magnetic_check.q_max' --magnetic-denominators '$magnetic.magnetic_check.denominators') && #else config_args+=(--no-magnetic-precheck) && #end if config_args+=( $safeguards.main_prenudge $safeguards.main_shadow_filter $safeguards.cleanup.main_cleanup $safeguards.cleanup.refine_uiso $safeguards.cleanup.refine_positions ) && "\${config_args[@]}" > '$console_output' 2>&1

param.name: gsas_validation_limit
param.label: Final refinement checks
param.help: Zero stops after lattice-aware pattern scoring.

param.name: family_variants
param.label: Keep alternate members of near-stoichiometric families

param.name: nudge_candidates
param.label: Candidates sent to lattice nudging per round

param.name: compare_candidates
param.label: Candidates compared in each commit cycle

param.name: rwp_improvement_threshold
param.label: Stop when Rwp improvement falls below

validator.message: Enter at least one sample element.

param.name: include_kbeta
param.label: Also mask Cu K-beta companion positions

param.name: main_prenudge
param.label: Automatically anchor a supplied main-phase cell

param.name: main_shadow_filter
param.label: Filter candidates supported only by strong main-phase peaks

tool.help: Creates a path-independent scientific configuration for RADAR-PD. Use this utility when the same settings will be applied to a mapped scan series, an automated Galaxy workflow, or repeated measurements. For a normal one-off analysis, use the primary **RADAR-PD** tool, which generates and returns the same configuration automatically.
